title: Veterinary clinic, new building on the owner's lot — Arroyo, pin dropped on the street inside FEMA AE + coastal zone
description: We are building a small veterinary clinic on a lot we own in Arroyo pueblo. It is a new one-story building. Two veterinarians and three staff.

mustInclude.rationale: RULE_0002 municipality baseline: every business gets the IRS EIN; employees also trigger RULE_0620.
RULE_0003 municipality baseline: Registro de Comerciante (SURI).
RULE_0004 municipality baseline: Patente Municipal (Ley 107-2020 Codigo Municipal).
RULE_0007: a physical commercial premises -> Permiso Unico (Ley 161-2009).
Business-type rule: the licensed professional (veterinarian / dentist) must hold the Junta Examinadora license.
RULE_0643: project_type new_construction -> OGPe construction permit (Ley 161-2009). This basis is the project, not the map, so the off-lot pin must not weaken it.

RULE_0706 (FEMA SFHA + new construction) fires, but the AE fact was read at a street pin (CRIM TIPO V / JP VIAL). REG-OFFLOT-PIN-001 keeps the Reg. 13 card so the flood review is never silently dropped, and asks the user to move the pin onto the lot before it is confirmed.

mustNotInclude.rationale: Not REQUIRED while the pin is on the street: the FEMA polygon describes the road, not the property (REG-OFFLOT-PIN-001).
Same: the coastal-zone fact was read at the street pin, so the coastal review cannot be REQUIRED until the pin is on the lot (REG-OFFLOT-PIN-001).
Pin on a road: zoning/land-class facts are withheld (layers.ts LOT_SCOPED_LAYERS), so no zoning-driven consulta can fire.

ordering.rationale: KB documents.json: DOC_PERMISO_UNICO depends on DOC_OGPE_CONSTRUCTION_PERMIT (use permit after construction).

notes: Added 2026-10-05 by the scenario loop to cover a street pin inside a flood + coastal zone (real Arroyo case), a new business type (veterinary clinic) and Arroyo as a municipality.
